title: Paris Peace Treaties
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Paris Peace Treaties, 1947", at revision 1369078996, opens: "The Paris Peace Treaties were signed on 10 February 1947 following the end of World War II in 1945. The Paris Peace Conference lasted from 29 July until 15 October 1946. The victorious wartime Allied powers negotiated the details of peace treaties with the former European Rome-Berlin-Tokyo Axis powers, namely Italy, Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, and Finland." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q322943, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaties signed in Paris on 10 February 1947". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
